cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(webview_native_contracts LANGUAGES CXX)
enable_testing()
add_executable(permission_test permission_test.cpp)
target_compile_features(permission_test PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
add_test(NAME permission_deferrals COMMAND permission_test)
add_executable(presentation_keys_test presentation_keys_test.cpp)
target_compile_features(presentation_keys_test PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
add_test(NAME presentation_keys COMMAND presentation_keys_test)
